Use one product shell with permission-aware navigation; avoid separate duplicated apps unless data isolation requires it.
Model each agent task as intent → authorized context retrieval → plan → user review → approval → execution → verification → audit log.
Require explicit approval for sending messages, submitting applications, publishing jobs, changing candidate stage, issuing offers, spending money, deleting data or other consequential actions.
Show AI-generated content labels, sources/evidence, confidence/limitations, tool actions and exact changes before execution.
Agents must inherit the requesting user's permissions, tenant scope, consent rules and record-level access. No agent service account bypass.
Use idempotency keys, retries with limits, timeouts, tool result verification, rollback where possible and clear partial-failure states.
Maintain task-specific evals for relevance, groundedness, fairness, privacy, tool correctness, latency and cost before model/prompt rollout.
Employer verification, job scam detection, candidate impersonation checks, abuse reporting, evidence retention and human appeals.
Do not infer protected traits; make ranking explainable; use job-related criteria; audit adverse impact where lawful and appropriate; retain human decision authority.

Design for India's DPDP framework: clear notice, purpose limitation, consent/other valid basis as applicable, data principal rights, security safeguards and grievance handling. Obtain legal review before launch.
Make region, retention, deletion, export, legal hold and processor controls configurable; validate sector/customer requirements.
Target WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard access, contrast, focus, labels, error messaging, captions and accessible charts.
Support INR, Indian number formats, IST and other time zones, Indian cities/pincodes, English plus future Indian languages, mobile/low-bandwidth flows.
Require structured role data, salary transparency where possible, location/work-mode clarity, expiry and employer verification.
Document numerator, denominator, cohort, attribution and time window for every KPI; suppress small cohorts where re-identification risk exists.
RBAC + tenant isolation + record-level authorization; encryption in transit/at rest; secret management; rate limiting; audit logs; vulnerability testing.
Every screen design must include loading, empty, error, success, permission denied, offline/partial failure and responsive states as relevant.
Define typography, spacing, colors, elevation, borders, status semantics, breakpoints and interaction patterns before high-fidelity screens.
Give each screen a stable ID; link Figma frame, API contract, user story, event names, owner and acceptance criteria during implementation.
Model employer plans, job credits, recruiter/agency seats, institution plans, promoted listings and partner rewards separately; avoid surprise charges.
Use domain events for application stage changes, interview scheduling, notifications, AI task lifecycle, billing and audit.
